passage.text: The next evening, Nam and Emma went to see the building manager, an old man called Uncle Wit.
passage.reading: ðə ˈnɛkst ˈiːvnɪŋ, ˈnɑːm ənd ˈɛmə ˈwɛnt tə ˈsiː ðə ˈbɪldɪŋ ˌmænɪdʒər, ən ˈoʊld ˈmæn ˈkɔːld ˈʌŋkəl ˈwɪt.

passage.text: Emma described the knocking, the footsteps and the shadow under the door.
passage.reading: ˈɛmə dɪˈskraɪbd ðə ˈnɑːkɪŋ, ðə ˈfʊtstɛps ənd ðə ˈʃædoʊ ˈʌndər ðə ˈdɔːr.

passage.text: Uncle Wit laughed. "I think I can solve your mystery," he said.
passage.reading: ˈʌŋkəl ˈwɪt ˈlæft. aɪ ˈθɪŋk aɪ kən ˈsɑːlv jʊr ˈmɪstəri, hiː ˈsɛd.

passage.text: He took them to the empty apartment above Emma's.
passage.reading: hiː ˈtʊk ðɛm tə ði ˈɛmpti əˈpɑːrtmənt əˈbʌv ˈɛməz.

passage.text: "Listen," he said, and he turned on the water in the kitchen.
passage.reading: ˈlɪsən, hiː ˈsɛd, ənd hiː ˈtɜːrnd ɑːn ðə ˈwɔːtər ɪn ðə ˈkɪtʃən.

passage.text: Suddenly, they heard knocking inside the walls.
passage.reading: ˈsʌdənli, ðeɪ ˈhɜːrd ˈnɑːkɪŋ ˌɪnˈsaɪd ðə ˈwɔːlz.

passage.text: "It's the old pipes," he explained. "When people use water at night, the pipes knock."
passage.reading: ɪts ði ˈoʊld ˈpaɪps, hiː ɪkˈspleɪnd. wɛn ˈpiːpəl ˈjuːz ˈwɔːtər ət ˈnaɪt, ðə ˈpaɪps ˈnɑːk.

passage.text: "But no one lives up here," said Emma.
passage.reading: bʌt ˈnoʊ ˌwʌn ˈlɪvz ˈʌp ˈhɪr, ˈsɛd ˈɛmə.

passage.text: "No, but the people on the top floor work in a restaurant, and they take showers at two a.m."
passage.reading: ˈnoʊ, bʌt ðə ˈpiːpəl ɑːn ðə ˈtɑːp ˈflɔːr ˈwɜːrk ɪn ə ˈrɛstərɑːnt, ənd ðeɪ ˈteɪk ˈʃaʊərz ət ˈtuː ˌeɪˈɛm.

passage.text: Uncle Wit pointed at the wall, where a big gecko was looking at them.
passage.reading: ˈʌŋkəl ˈwɪt ˈpɔɪntɪd ət ðə ˈwɔːl, wɛr ə ˈbɪɡ ˈɡɛkoʊ wʌz ˈlʊkɪŋ ət ˈðɛm.

passage.text: "Geckos run around at night, looking for insects. That's your ghost!" he said.
passage.reading: ˈɡɛkoʊz ˈrʌn əˈraʊnd ət ˈnaɪt, ˈlʊkɪŋ fər ˈɪnsɛkts. ðæts jʊr ˈɡoʊst! hiː ˈsɛd.

passage.text: And the shadow under the door? It was just the light from the hall.
passage.reading: ənd ðə ˈʃædoʊ ˈʌndər ðə ˈdɔːr? ɪt wʌz ˈdʒʌst ðə ˈlaɪt frəm ðə ˈhɔːl.

passage.text: "So it wasn't a ghost!" she said.
passage.reading: soʊ ɪt ˈwʌzənt ə ˈɡoʊst! ʃiː ˈsɛd.

passage.text: "I told you there was a logical explanation!" said Nam.
passage.reading: aɪ ˈtoʊld juː ðɛr wʌz ə ˈlɑːdʒɪkəl ˌɛkspləˈneɪʃən! ˈsɛd ˈnɑːm.
